notes: Mechanical rubric for the policy-authoring eval. Bonus points are reported beside the score and never added to it. See README.md for the matcher language. Rules are read from `xano policy parse -o json` against the eval workspace, so params include their catalogue defaults. Regexes are case-insensitive. A reply `none` regex ignores a match preceded within 40 characters by a negation (not, n't, never, no, cannot, without...). v4 (2026-10-12): G10 reads the ask as approval before delete/email (deletes_guarded, approval_before_email); G14 audit_trail accepts the audit_changes recipe form. v5: must_be_inside accepts try_catch.try, the named form of try_catch's try branch. Rescore older labels after a rubric change.
